name: ModelVariant651_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant651_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (shaded strip rings spin out of a model point, a dome of strips grows over the slot row by row, and each finished row sends up a spinning cone of strips); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-668/735 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant668_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH, without the work-size printf, and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
